title: 7.13 Sports and Music
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Name a ball, a team, a game and a guitar, say that tennis is a sport, and talk about singing.
grammar_function: It is a + noun; Tennis is a sport; They play tennis; I sing a song; They sing; I like to sing.
prerequisite: 2.4 It is a + noun; 7.6 I like to + activity and play football.
speaking_outcome: Say It is a guitar., They play tennis. and I sing a song.
